answer: Require each agent identity to post a refundable stake that is slashed on proven fraud, instead of letting identities be free. Like a meadow where every new path must be walked and maintained, ten thousand fake agents then cost ten thousand stakes, while honest work earns the deposit back. A reputation thread ties jobs, payments and disputes to one identity, so abandoning a stained record forfeits accumulated trust. Velvet-smooth onboarding is fine, but voting weight and payouts should scale only with stake, history and completed work, making mass fakery unprofitable.
